content:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem for the cache-eviction incident. I sketched 3 remediation items — we need owners, JIRA links, and a short RACI. Can folks confirm owners by EOD?

alex: Remediation items I have: 1) persistent cache TTL audit, 2) eviction backpressure fix (throttling/batching), 3) cross-region failover runbook + test plan.

priya: I can own #1 (TTL audit). Will create the JIRA and drop the link here.

luke: I can help QA #1 with @priya. I'll take #2 as owner if eng-infra can help with kernel-level tuning. @maria can you be C for #2?

maria: I can review (#2) but bandwith is tight this sprint. If possible, shift due date 2w.

devon: I'll pick up #3 (runbook + automated test). I'll create REDWOOD-8421 now and add a checklist.

priya: created REDWOOD-8419 for TTL audit — link: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-8419. ETA 2026-04-10. cc @luke

alex: thanks. Quick RACI template so we’re explicit: R=owner, A=approver, C=consulted, I=informed.

luke: Proposed RACI: #1 R=Priya, A=Alex, C=Eng-Infra (Maria), I=Support+SRE. #2 R=Luke, A=Eng-Platform lead (TBD), C=Maria, I=Ops. #3 R=Devon, A=Product, C=SRE, I=Oncall.

maria: A for #2 is fine as long as we get someone from infra in the loop early. If timeline moves, I can be more hands-on.

devon: REDWOOD-8421 created for runbook: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-8421. I'll add the test checklist and a small-scale rollback plan. ETA 2026-04-05.

opsbot: Reminder: please tag tickets with `component=postmortem` and `severity=sev3` when created. Use the slash helper or include tags in description.

alex: Example for creating a JIRA from Slack if helpful:
```
/jira create --project REDWOOD --summary "TTL audit for persistent cache" --component postmortem
```

priya: added the prompt set and repro steps to REDWOOD-8419. Also flagging a recurring pattern: evictions spike when a handful of customers send very long sequences — we should add a metric.

luke: Agreed. I'll open an alert ticket REDWOOD-8430 for a monitoring rule: alert when per-customer 95th percentile token-length > threshold over 5m.

maria: Timeline proposal if owners confirmed now: #1 due 2026-04-10, #2 due 2026-04-17, #3 due 2026-04-05. Is that workable?

alex: That works for me. I'll update the postmortem doc and calendar invites. Please add any blockers to the JIRA tickets. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: will keep updates in the ticket.

devon: I'll add automated test cases to REDWOOD-8421 by EOD tomorrow.

luke: I'll follow up with eng-infra to get a small allocation for kernel/queue investigation.

maria: If anyone needs me to escalate for more capacity, ping me directly.

alex: Great. I'll close the loop once tickets have owners and dates; will mark this thread as the canonical follow-up.
